title: Mosque Mobile App
description: My final year project. An app for my local mosque with prayer times, reminders and announcements. Ionic couldn't do everything I needed, so I wrote some custom Java plugins.

title: Cloud File Transfer
description: Upload a file on one device, download it on another. Files are stored on Cloudflare R2 and only kept for a while.

title: Malaysia Prayer Times Bot
description: Get today's prayer times for any zone in Malaysia, using JAKIM's e-Solat data. Pick your state and zone once and it remembers them. Works in English and Bahasa Melayu.

title: Image & PDF Compressor Bot
description: A Telegram bot that shrinks JPEG, PNG, GIF and PDF files. You pick the quality and it remembers your setting. Files are deleted right after they're sent back.

title: Speech to Text Bot
description: Send it a voice note or audio file and it replies with the transcript. It uses Whisper and detects the language on its own.

title: OT & Claim Tracker Bot
description: A Telegram bot for logging overtime hours and work claims. It shows a monthly summary and can export records to Excel or PDF.

title: Intern Logbook
description: For interns to log what they did each day. It has a page-flip preview and a share link, so supervisors can read it online.

title: Sudoku Web Game
description: Sudoku in the browser. Play solo or against a friend in real time.

title: Chocolicious
description: A small online chocolate shop. Browse, check a product, place an order.
